from pathlib import Path

suffix = \".faa.mafft\"
number_re = re.compile(r'"'^[+-]?'"\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:[eE][+-]?\\d+)?%?"'$'"')

def parse_phykit_pis(stdout):
    for line in stdout.splitlines():
        tokens = re.split(r'[\\t ]+', line.strip())
        nums = [t.rstrip('%') for t in tokens if number_re.match(t)]
        if len(nums) >= 3:
            return int(float(nums[0])), int(float(nums[1])), nums[2]
    for line in stdout.splitlines():
        tokens = re.split(r'[\\t ]+', line.strip())
        nums = [t.rstrip('%') for t in tokens if number_re.match(t)]
        if nums:
            return int(float(nums[0])), \"\", \"\"
    raise ValueError(\"Could not parse PhyKIT pis output: {}\".format(stdout))

with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as zf:
    infos = [i for i in zf.infolist() if not i.is_dir() and i.filename.endswith(suffix)]
    infos.sort(key=lambda i: i.filename)
    if not infos:
        raise SystemExit(\"No members ending with {} found\".format(suffix))
    best = None
